summary: This 424B5 amendment fixes the size of a continuous at-the-market offering of up to $50,000 in ADSs by XCHG Ltd via sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. It supplements prior prospectus materials and reflects typical shelf takedown mechanics under Rule 424(b)(5). There is no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation; it is a routine capital markets filing.
